ocr.notes: First sentence right; the rest has dropped and garbled lines ('waiting to sign the articles en route here', 'confident of success', 'soft thing' missing).

title.suggested: Allen Telegraphs Mace Accepting His Challenge

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen had telegraphed Jem Mace in New York accepting his challenge to fight for $2,500 a side in Louisiana or Canada within six months, and that the articles were en route.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, January 9, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen reportedly telegraphed Jem Mace in New York accepting his challenge to fight for $2,500 a side in Louisiana or Canada within six months; articles were en route to St. Louis for signing

notes: Paper says Allen was confident of success and Mace thought he had 'decidedly a soft thing'.
